headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING

periods.name: Rest of tonight
periods.text: North winds 15 to 25 knots. A chance of rain late this evening, then a slight chance of rain after midnight. Waves 4 to 7 feet subsiding to 3 to 6 feet. Waves occasionally around 9 feet.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: North winds 15 to 20 knots diminishing to 10 to 15 knots. A chance of rain. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Friday night
periods.text: North winds 15 to 20 knots becoming northwest. A chance of rain in the evening. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots. Partly sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Sunday through Tuesday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 54 degrees, off Cleveland 58 degrees, and off Erie 55 degrees.
